turns.doctor_question: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. 

Well, I'm here because... I've gotten to the point where I basically plan my whole summer around avoiding wasps. It's just getting to be too much. I've even had to give up my garden jobs at the church because I can't be out there. And at home, if I hear even a little buzzing outside, I make my husband unload things by the back porch so I don't have to go near them. I just go completely out of my way to avoid them.

symptom_reasoning.S064: The patient explicitly describes actively avoiding wasps to the point of giving up activities and altering her daily routines.
